Definition: from G4052; a surplus, or superabundance:--abundance, that was left, over and above.
BiblicalUsage: Perisseuma is the surplus, what is left over and above. Paul says the Corinthians' abundance should supply the want of others, and Jesus says out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that the surplus shows the heart: what overflows from me is what I am full of, and I would rather overflow with grace.
